description: Score pronunciation accuracy at phoneme level against a reference text. Returns accuracy, fluency, completeness, and prosody scores (0–100) plus per-word and per-phoneme breakdowns. Supports 30+ locales (en-US, fr-FR, de-DE, zh-CN, ar-SA, etc.). Audio should be a clear reading of the reference text.

audioPath.description: WAV recording of the speaker reading the reference text

referenceText.description: The text the speaker was reading aloud

name: vocametrix_assess_pronunciation
